24.original: Place the sautéed mushroom soup as bait.

25.original: Lie in wait for the pest.

26.original: Report to the Nu Mou culinarian.

48.original: Nooo, not again! Grrr, a pox on that pest!

49.original: My, to appear before me precisely at my time of need! 'Tis as if you were a Nu Mou yourself!

50.original: It's my mushrooms─the precious mushrooms I grow with tender loving care. A dastardly pest has been laying them to waste!

51.original: It sneaks into the cave with its gluttonous, googly eyes, and devours my defenseless fungi before vanishing into the wilderness!

52.original: Rid me of the creature, I beg you! Lure it out using this bowl of sautéed mushroom soup, then strike it down!

53.original: Rid me of that dastardly pest, I beg you! Lure it out using the sautéed mushroom soup, then strike it down!

54.original: You did it! You rid me of the mushroom menace!

55.original: Now my precious mushrooms may grow in peace, and I can sleep without those googly eyes haunting my dreams.

56.original: Here is your fitting reward─no more and no less than you deserve. May it bring you much honor!
